contentSections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Alvastra was a Cistercian monastery in Östergötland, founded in 1143 as one of the first Cistercian houses in Sweden. It was established under royal and noble patronage and became an important center of religious and political life.

contentSections.title: Legacy
paragraphs: Sverker I of Sweden was associated with Alvastra and was buried there after his murder in 1156. The monastery's Cistercian connection also made it significant for Birgitta of Sweden in the fourteenth century, who received visions near Alvastra that became foundational to her spiritual biography.
